title: Section 1: Defining our brand
slide_intent: Prepare the reader for a change from navigation to explanation. A chapter opener can identify the questions the next pages answer.
strategic_value: Slack can establish a recurring chapter rhythm through a solid aubergine field and a small set of consistent text positions.
demonstration: A section label and fine white rule sit near the top of an aubergine page. A short pale paragraph below introduces the brand’s beliefs, distinctions and language.
practical_value: Use a section opener to announce the scope of a chapter while leaving detailed arguments to the pages that follow.

content_islands.name: Section heading
content_islands.spec: Place the bold white chapter number and title at upper left with a thin white rule below.

content_islands.name: Chapter summary
content_islands.spec: Set a short light-weight paragraph in a narrow left column beneath the rule. Leave the rest of the aubergine field open.
